## What does this change?

Describe the change and the motivation. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check:all` passes locally (or I explain why not)
- [ ] Changes to the shared core were checked against all seven build targets, not just the active variant
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README, docs/, variant README) if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] The feature flag table is regenerated if `shared/features.ts` changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No third party content is included without a compatible license
